all.title: S1 for all
all.summary: The single current next action is Agnes's official access setup while Manou waits on outside proof and replies.

manou.title: Manou
manou.summary: Priority lane is blocked on outside inputs: ownership proof, locksmith/registry movement, accepted empadronamiento proof, and the French healthcare answer.

manou-property.title: Ownership Proof
manou-property.summary: Wait for the property registry result and use only the non-sensitive conclusion in project notes.

manou-safe.title: Safe / Locksmiths
manou-safe.summary: Compare locksmith responses and keep the authority/proof packet private until a provider is chosen.

manou-safe-cf.title: CF / WhatsApp
manou-safe-cf.summary: First firm quote path is the baseline; hold booking until the competing quote and proof packet are evaluated.

manou-safe-bermudez.title: Bermudez / Email
manou-safe-bermudez.summary: Photos were sent by email; wait for price, proof requirements, invoice, and timing.

manou-safe-fpoint.title: FPoint / Email
manou-safe-fpoint.summary: Second-wave email outreach stays open until a reply or timeout.

manou-safe-vallejo.title: Vallejo / Email

manou-safe-mayorga.title: Mayorga / Email
manou-safe-mayorga.summary: Email quote path remains open for response monitoring.

manou-safe-authority.title: Proof Packet
manou-safe-authority.summary: Prepare proof only after ownership evidence and the provider handoff are confirmed; keep identity and property documents private.

manou-padron.title: Empadronamiento
manou-padron.summary: Wait for primary housing proof, ideally the nota simple or IBI/title deed, before attempting the one-trip Fuengirola visit.

manou-health.title: Healthcare Route
manou-health.summary: Wait for the CNAV / Assurance Retraite answer before choosing S1, an alternate exportable document, or the Spanish fallback path.

agnes.title: Agnes
agnes.summary: Determine whether Agnes has independent French retirement rights while also preserving the spouse/beneficiary route through Elie's S1.

agnes-retirement.title: Own Retirement Rights
agnes-retirement.summary: Create or recover official FranceConnect access first, then inspect career records and summarize only high-level conclusions.

agnes-beneficiary.title: Beneficiary Route
agnes-beneficiary.summary: Ask for Agnes to be included in Elie's pensioner S1 request where possible.

agnes-eu.title: EU Residence Support
agnes-eu.summary: Gather private-insurance and residence evidence only if the administrative route requires it.

elie.title: Elie
elie.summary: Request the French pensioner S1 after Agnes's immediate access step is blocked or complete.

elie-s1.title: S1 Request
elie-s1.summary: Create Elie's own official access as setup, then submit the pensioner S1 request including Agnes where possible.

elie-spain.title: INSS / Andalucia
elie-spain.summary: Once the S1 exists, register it with Spain and move to the regional health-card step.

ops.title: Ops / Monitoring
ops.summary: Keep the monitor, timelog, GitHub handoff, and privacy rules current.

tasks.title: Protect private material
tasks.body: Keep the public page useful without exposing private facts.
details: No scans, full identifiers, exact address, photos, payment details, or account data.
Use only operational labels, roles, and non-sensitive conclusions.
Downloaded documents stay outside GitHub Pages unless deliberately approved.

tasks.title: Round-robin discipline
tasks.body: Manou first; when blocked, advance Agnes; when Agnes is blocked, advance Elie.
details: Manou is priority because the residence/healthcare situation is urgent.
Agnes gets retirement-rights discovery when Manou is waiting.
Elie's S1 lane moves when the first two lanes are blocked.

tasks.title: Created the public task-tree page
tasks.body: Built the first GitHub Pages version and attached it to the Webapps hub.
details: Added the S1 tree as a local static app.
Added a hub tile and deploy workflow path.
Verified the public URL after GitHub Pages deployment.
tasks.witness: Live page and hub card published as v85.0; this revision deepens it to v85.7 with self-expanding cards, lane-safe layout, a corrected access-first queue, and JSON-backed task data.

tasks.title: Promoted Agnes while Manou waits
tasks.body: Reclassified Manou's empadronamiento and healthcare work as waiting so Agnes is now the next actionable lane.
details: Empadronamiento waits on accepted housing proof, ideally nota simple or IBI/title.
Healthcare waits on the CNAV / Assurance Retraite answer.
The current queue now starts with Agnes retirement-rights discovery.
tasks.witness: This v85.7 page shows Manou as waiting and Agnes as the first current queue item.

tasks.title: Confirmed property-search starting point
tasks.body: Identified the correct public property record context without putting the exact address on this public page.
details: Matched the apartment through public property-search context.
Recorded the sensitive particulars only in the private project repo.
Kept this page to the operational conclusion: property proof is in progress.
tasks.witness: Private S1 docs contain the source trail; public page only shows the lane state.

tasks.title: Started registry proof request
tasks.body: Submitted the property registry request and confirmed it entered processing.
details: The request was submitted through the official property-registry channel.
Confirmation email was received.
No registry PDF or application number is published here.
tasks.witness: Private repo records the date and status; the public witness is the completed task card.

tasks.title: Watch for registry result
tasks.body: When the registry email arrives, Elie downloads it outside the repo and reports only the ownership conclusion.
details: Expected useful output: whether the expected owner is named.
If clean, use it as primary proof for empadronamiento and safe-opening authority.
If not clean, record only the non-sensitive problem category.

tasks.title: Build private authority packet
tasks.body: Wait for clean ownership proof, then combine it privately with identity/presence and utility evidence.
details: Property proof acts as the anchor.
Identity proof stays private and is shown only to the appropriate office/provider.
Electric bills are backup/supporting evidence, not the only planned proof.

tasks.title: Captured safe constraints
tasks.body: The working constraints are clear enough to quote safely.
details: No key and no combination are available.
The family does not need the safe restored for reuse.
Primary purpose is document recovery for family/property administration.
tasks.witness: Provider conversations and private notes established the constraints.

tasks.title: Sent initial locksmith outreach
tasks.body: Multiple providers were contacted with a privacy-light quote request.
details: Asked capability, quote process, proof requirements, non-destructive opening, invoice, and timing.
Did not include exact address, full name, ID numbers, property documents, or safe photos in the first emails.
Separated first-wave and second-wave outreach to avoid duplicate sending.
tasks.witness: Emails sent and tracked in the private S1 log.

tasks.title: Restored the sent Vallejo email
tasks.body: Corrected mailbox state after a sent email had been accidentally moved to Trash.
details: Verified the email had actually been sent.
Restored it to normal Sent status.
Placed it back on equal footing with other provider outreach.
tasks.witness: Private Gmail state was corrected; no message body is published here.

tasks.title: Watch Vallejo reply
tasks.body: Keep the restored sent email in the active quote pool.
details: Treat it as a live provider path, not an accidental duplicate.
Compare any reply against the WhatsApp quote and the photo-based email quote.
Record only public-safe conclusions here.

tasks.title: Received first firm opening quote
tasks.body: One provider gave an opening price and basic documentation expectation.
details: Provider understands no key/no combination.
Provider understands no repair/reuse is needed.
The proof packet likely includes ID plus some house document, with the owner present.
tasks.witness: WhatsApp exchange summarized privately; public page keeps only the operational result.

tasks.title: Hold CF booking until quote comparison
tasks.body: Use this path as the current baseline but wait for the competing photo-based quote if timing allows.
details: Confirm whether travel and invoice are included.
Confirm earliest appointment only after comparing the second quote.
Keep the owner-present and house-document requirement ready but private.

tasks.title: Prepared safe photos for quoting
tasks.body: Photos were handled in a privacy-light way before forwarding to the provider who asked.
details: User exported safe photos to the local repo only.
Metadata was stripped before sharing.
A single contact sheet was created and sent by email.
tasks.witness: Private Gmail sent state confirms the photo reply went out.

tasks.title: Wait for Bermudez quote
tasks.body: A provider has the safe photos and should reply with price, invoice, timing, and proof requirements.
details: Compare against the existing quote before booking.
Watch whether travel/call-out is included.
Capture whether destructive opening is expected.

tasks.title: Watch FPoint reply
tasks.body: Keep this second-wave email path open while the automation checks for movement.
details: Useful reply fields: can open this type of safe, price range, timing, proof requirements, and invoice.
If no reply arrives after the active comparison window, mark it stale privately.
Do not resend the same first-contact email.

tasks.title: Watch Mayorga reply
tasks.body: Keep this email path in the quote pool until a reply or timeout.
details: Compare any useful quote against the WhatsApp path and the photo-based email path.
Avoid sending documents or address details until appointment logistics require it.
Escalate only if this becomes the best price/timing candidate.

tasks.title: Confirm all-in price before booking
tasks.body: Ask whether travel, opening, invoice, and any destructive-opening caveat are included.
details: Confirm earliest possible appointment.
Confirm what exact documents are required on-site.
Prefer written confirmation before sending any private documents.

tasks.title: Do not send authority docs casually
tasks.body: Keep identity and property proof private until the recipient and exact content are approved.
details: No ID photos in WhatsApp by default.
No exact address by email until appointment logistics require it.
No registry PDF or utility bill copy without deliberate approval.

tasks.title: Verified Fuengirola packet shape
tasks.body: The empadronamiento packet has a concrete checklist.
details: Core form and identity requirements are known.
Property proof route and owner-authorization fallback are documented privately.
Electric bills are available as backup.
tasks.witness: Private S1 docs contain the checklist and official-source notes.

tasks.title: Assemble appointment folder
tasks.body: Wait for primary housing proof, then make one physical packet that can survive a town-hall counter visit.
details: Forms, identity document, copy, contact details, and payment method.
Property proof if the registry result arrives in time.
Electric bills as backup/supporting evidence.

tasks.title: Plan one assisted visit
tasks.body: Best route is Manou attending and signing in person, with support, once the proof packet is strong enough.
details: Minimize trips because leaving home is difficult.
Confirm whether Leonarda can accompany locally.
If Manou cannot attend, call the office before relying on representation.

tasks.title: Obtained current French health-rights attestation
tasks.body: The French health-coverage baseline is documented privately.
details: Active rights were confirmed from the official French account.
Sensitive medical and account details are not published here.
This became the starting point for the French exportability question.
tasks.witness: Private S1 docs record the attestation date and non-sensitive status.

tasks.title: Captured CPAM redirect
tasks.body: CPAM directed the question to the retirement channel.
details: This changed the next French contact from health office to retirement office.
The question now includes S1/exportability and possible widow/reversion rights.
The page does not publish account messages.
tasks.witness: Private conversation log records the redirect.

tasks.title: Send CNAV / Assurance Retraite question
tasks.body: Wait for Sophie/CNAV movement on whether S1 or any equivalent exportable healthcare document exists, and whether any widow/reversion route makes CNAV competent.
details: Ask for a written answer.
Ask who can issue non-exportability proof if France cannot export rights.
Ask who is competent if CNAV is not.

tasks.title: Branch after written answer
tasks.body: Use the written French answer to choose the Spanish route.
details: If exportable document exists: register in Spain.
If no exportable right exists: preserve the refusal/non-exportability proof.
If redirected: follow the named competent institution.

tasks.title: Captured Agnes identity baseline
tasks.body: The retirement-rights lane has the personal facts needed for official portal work, without publishing identifiers.
details: Name and broad identity context are known privately.
The personal number is used only on official portals.
This public page avoids birth details and social-security numbers.
tasks.witness: Private S1 docs note that the card was reviewed without transcribing the full number.

tasks.title: Opened Agnes retirement lane
tasks.body: Created the checklist for determining whether Agnes has her own French pension rights.
details: Official access setup is the first concrete step.
Career record review is the main evidence source.
Only high-level conclusions should be summarized.
tasks.witness: Private repo contains the Agnes retirement next-actions file.

tasks.title: Create Ameli / FranceConnect access
tasks.body: Create or recover Agnes's official access before entering the retirement portal.
details: Prefer ameli if the online creation flow accepts the card and registered bank details.
Use the personal number only in the official flow.
Do not store passwords, one-time codes, screenshots, or downloaded statements in this public workspace.

tasks.title: Access Info Retraite
tasks.body: Wait until FranceConnect access exists, then enter the retirement portal and list the available career documents.
details: Confirm whether the login works.
Check which retirement regimes appear.
Record only whether documents exist and which high-level categories are visible.

tasks.title: Review high-level career record
tasks.body: Wait until portal access works, then capture regimes found, broad quarters/points status, and obvious missing periods without publishing detailed records.
details: Look for employment, self-employment, childcare, unemployment, sickness, and missing periods.
Summarize by category, not by sensitive full statements.
Identify whether an independent pension/S1 route is plausible.

tasks.title: Check child, maternity, AVPF, gaps
tasks.body: Look for periods that may affect rights or corrections once the official statement is visible.
details: Child-related credits can be material.
Missing periods may need correction requests.
Corrections wait until the official record is visible.

tasks.title: Tie Agnes to Elie's S1 request
tasks.body: Ask for an individual nominative S1 or dependent recognition where the French/Spanish process allows it.
details: This depends partly on Elie's S1 request.
The request should mention spouse/family-member handling explicitly.
If refused, preserve the reason for the Spanish office.

tasks.title: Request insurance certificate only if needed
tasks.body: If EU residence paperwork needs private-insurance proof, ask for a certificate matching Spanish requirements.
details: Certificate should confirm active coverage and relevant Spanish scope.
Only pursue if the administrative route requires it.
Do not publish policy numbers.

tasks.title: Opened Elie's S1 lane
tasks.body: Separated Elie's pensioner S1 work from Manou and Agnes lanes.
details: Elie has the basic pensioner fact pattern for a French S1 request.
Agnes should be included where possible.
Only submission facts and references should be stored.
tasks.witness: Private repo contains the Elie S1 next-actions file and draft.

tasks.title: Calculated check-key workflow
tasks.body: Established how to calculate the French number check key for official use without publishing the full number.
details: The rule was documented privately from official schema notes.
The public page does not include the number or the key.
Use only in official portals/forms.
tasks.witness: Private source notes preserve the algorithm.

tasks.title: Create Elie Ameli / FranceConnect access
tasks.body: Set up Elie's own official access as preparation for the S1 request.
details: Useful for health and pension portals.
Not the only possible submission channel.
Keep credentials and one-time codes out of the project.

tasks.title: Submit French pensioner S1 request
tasks.body: Use the prepared draft, include Agnes where possible, and save only submission date, channel, and reference number.
details: Target the competent French retirement channel.
Ask for individual/nominative handling for spouse if available.
Do not put portal screenshots or full identifiers into the public app.

tasks.title: Register S1 with INSS / CAISS
tasks.body: After the S1 arrives, move to Spanish registration and then the Andalucian health-card step.
details: Spanish registration waits for the actual S1.
Then move to regional health-card logistics.
Record only non-sensitive status transitions.

tasks.title: Moved tree data into JSON
tasks.body: Made the public task-tree app render from a plain data file instead of hard-coding the operational state in the page script.
details: Tree structure, node status, blockers, queue labels, and task cards now live in task-tree.json.
The web app fetches the JSON and renders it on load.
Future public-safe updates can usually edit only the data file.
tasks.witness: The app source now fetches s1/task-tree.json; the data file carries version v85.7.

tasks.title: Copied timelog SOP and started active-time tracking
tasks.body: The S1 repo now has a clear rule for counting only active collaboration time.
details: Golden timelog SOP was copied into the private repo.
Active collaboration time is logged conservatively.
Background tool/runtime time is excluded.
tasks.witness: Private S1 repo has the SOP and TIMELOG.

tasks.title: Installed Telegram communication monitor
tasks.body: Email and local WhatsApp checks run during Spain daytime and alert by Telegram only when new movement appears.
details: Launchd job runs every two hours during daytime.
Apple Mail's Gmail index and local WhatsApp Desktop database are watched.
Telegram route was tested, including phone/watch notification behavior.
tasks.witness: Private S1 repo contains monitor script, launchd plist, and docs.

tasks.title: Published Webapps hub integration
tasks.body: The S1 task tree was added to the Webapps hub and deployed through GitHub Pages.
details: Created a standalone static page.
Added a shared logo and hub card.
Verified public URLs after deployment.
tasks.witness: Webapps commit and GitHub Pages deployment are the witness.

tasks.title: Added English / French switch
tasks.body: The S1 page can now switch languages while reading both languages from task-tree.json.
details: UI labels are localized from the JSON data file.
Operational text uses a French translation dictionary in the same JSON file.
New strings fall back to English until a French translation is added.
tasks.witness: Version v85.7 adds the EN/FR toggle and keeps the app shell data-light.

tasks.title: Keep GitHub handoffs fresh
tasks.body: Update docs, timelog, and backlog when material facts change, without copying private documents into the site.
details: Commit and push only public-safe changes.
Keep private repo as source of truth for sensitive operational details.
Use this page as a dashboard, not a records vault.

fr.Operational map for Manou, Agnes, and El: Carte opérationnelle pour Manou, Agnes et Elie. Version publique : pas d’identifiants, d’adresses exactes, de scans ni de données de compte.
fr.Task content, priorities, blockers, and: Le contenu des tâches, les priorités, les blocages et la structure de l’arbre vivent dans ce fichier JSON. L’application affiche ce fichier et ne contient que la logique de présentation.
fr.One current next leaf, with its parent p: Une seule feuille active « à faire », avec tout son chemin parent mis en évidence.
fr.Priority lane, currently blocked on outs: Voie prioritaire, actuellement bloquée par des preuves et réponses externes.
fr.Registry result not downloaded yet; IBI/: Résultat du registre pas encore téléchargé ; IBI/titre de propriété pas encore localisé.
fr.Quote paths, proof gate, and booking dec: Pistes de devis, contrôle des justificatifs et décision de rendez-vous.
fr.Compare against competing quote before b: Comparer avec le devis concurrent avant de réserver ; confirmer le prix tout compris et les justificatifs requis si cette piste est choisie.
fr.Waiting for price, factura, timing, proo: En attente du prix, de la facture, du délai, des justificatifs requis et de la méthode d’ouverture après envoi des photos.
fr.No useful reply yet from the email quote: Pas encore de réponse utile par cette piste email.
fr.Sent email is restored and live; no inbo: L’email envoyé est rétabli et actif ; pas encore de devis reçu.
fr.No inbound quote yet from this provider: Pas encore de devis reçu par cette piste fournisseur.
fr.Need clean ownership proof and chosen pr: Besoin d’une preuve de propriété claire et d’un fournisseur choisi avant de partager des documents privés.
fr.Need primary housing proof: nota simple,: Besoin d’une preuve principale du logement : nota simple, IBI ou titre de propriété. Les factures d’électricité restent seulement un appoint.
fr.Manou can attend/sign, or Fuengirola acc: Manou peut se présenter/signer, ou Fuengirola accepte une représentation pour cette visite.
fr.Need CNAV / Assurance Retraite written a: Besoin d’une réponse écrite de la CNAV / Assurance Retraite sur le S1, un autre document exportable ou la non-exportabilité.
fr.Spanish/Andalucia route depends on that: La voie espagnole/andalouse dépend de cette réponse et de l’empadronamiento.
fr.Retirement-rights discovery and possible: Vérification des droits retraite et possible voie S1 comme ayant droit.
fr.Need Elie's S1 request and official answ: Besoin de la demande S1 d’Elie et d’une réponse officielle sur la possibilité de traiter Agnes comme épouse/membre de famille.
fr.Pensioner S1 request follows when Agnes: La demande S1 retraité suit quand Agnes est bloquée ou terminée.
fr.The single current next action is Agnes': La seule prochaine action active est la création/récupération de l’accès officiel d’Agnes pendant que Manou attend des preuves et réponses externes.
fr.Priority lane is blocked on outside inpu: La voie prioritaire est bloquée par des éléments externes : preuve de propriété, avancées serrurier/registre, preuve acceptée pour l’empadronamiento et réponse française santé.
fr.Wait for the property registry result an: Attendre le résultat du registre de propriété et ne noter que la conclusion non sensible.
fr.Compare locksmith responses and keep the: Comparer les réponses des serruriers et garder le dossier d’autorité/justificatifs privé jusqu’au choix d’un fournisseur.
fr.First firm quote path is the baseline; h: La première piste avec prix ferme sert de référence ; attendre le devis concurrent et l’évaluation du dossier avant de réserver.
fr.Photos were sent by email; wait for pric: Photos envoyées par email ; attendre prix, justificatifs requis, facture et délai.
fr.Second-wave email outreach stays open un: La relance email de deuxième vague reste ouverte jusqu’à réponse ou expiration.
fr.Sent email was restored and now sits on: L’email envoyé a été rétabli et compte comme les autres pistes de devis email.
fr.Email quote path remains open for respon: La piste de devis email reste ouverte pour surveillance.
fr.Prepare proof only after ownership evide: Préparer les justificatifs seulement après confirmation de la preuve de propriété et du fournisseur ; garder les documents d’identité et de propriété privés.
fr.Wait for primary housing proof, ideally: Attendre la preuve principale du logement, idéalement la nota simple ou l’IBI/titre, avant de tenter une visite unique à Fuengirola.
fr.Wait for the CNAV / Assurance Retraite a: Attendre la réponse CNAV / Assurance Retraite avant de choisir entre S1, autre document exportable ou solution de repli espagnole.
fr.Determine whether Agnes has independent: Déterminer si Agnes a des droits retraite français propres tout en préservant la voie épouse/ayant droit via le S1 d’Elie.
fr.Create or recover official FranceConnect: Créer ou récupérer d’abord l’accès officiel FranceConnect, puis consulter le relevé de carrière et résumer seulement les conclusions générales.
fr.Ask for Agnes to be included in Elie's p: Demander l’inclusion d’Agnes dans la demande S1 retraité d’Elie lorsque c’est possible.
fr.Gather private-insurance and residence e: Rassembler les preuves d’assurance privée et de résidence seulement si la voie administrative l’exige.
fr.Request the French pensioner S1 after Ag: Demander le S1 retraité français après blocage ou achèvement de l’étape d’accès d’Agnes.
fr.Create Elie's own official access as set: Créer l’accès officiel propre d’Elie comme préparation, puis soumettre la demande S1 retraité en incluant Agnes si possible.
fr.Once the S1 exists, register it with Spa: Une fois le S1 obtenu, l’enregistrer en Espagne puis passer à l’étape de la carte sanitaire régionale.
fr.Keep the monitor, timelog, GitHub handof: Tenir à jour la surveillance, le suivi du temps, le passage GitHub et les règles de confidentialité.
fr.Promoted Agnes while Manou waits: Agnes passe devant pendant l’attente Manou
fr.Confirmed property-search starting point: Point de départ de recherche propriété confirmé
fr.Started registry proof request: Demande de preuve au registre lancée
fr.Hold CF booking until quote comparison: Attendre la comparaison avant rendez-vous CF
fr.Prepared safe photos for quoting: Photos du coffre préparées pour devis
fr.Confirm all-in price before booking: Confirmer prix tout compris avant réservation
fr.Do not send authority docs casually: Ne pas envoyer les justificatifs à la légère
fr.Obtained current French health-rights at: Attestation française de droits santé obtenue
fr.Send CNAV / Assurance Retraite question: Envoyer la question CNAV / Assurance Retraite
fr.Branch after written answer: Choisir la branche après réponse écrite
fr.Review high-level career record: Examiner le relevé de carrière global
fr.Check child, maternity, AVPF, gaps: Vérifier enfants, maternité, AVPF et trous
fr.Tie Agnes to Elie's S1 request: Rattacher Agnes à la demande S1 d’Elie
fr.Request insurance certificate only if ne: Demander l’attestation d’assurance seulement si nécessaire
fr.Calculated check-key workflow: Procédure de clé de contrôle calculée
fr.Submit French pensioner S1 request: Soumettre la demande S1 retraité française
fr.Register S1 with INSS / CAISS: Enregistrer le S1 auprès de l’INSS / CAISS
fr.Moved tree data into JSON: Données de l’arbre déplacées dans le JSON
fr.Copied timelog SOP and started active-ti: SOP de suivi du temps copié et suivi actif lancé
fr.Keep GitHub handoffs fresh: Garder les relais GitHub à jour
fr.Keep the public page useful without expo: Garder la page publique utile sans exposer de faits privés.
fr.No scans, full identifiers, exact addres: Pas de scans, identifiants complets, adresse exacte, photos, données de paiement ou données de compte.
fr.Use only operational labels, roles, and: Utiliser seulement des libellés opérationnels, rôles et conclusions non sensibles.
